description: Comprehensive tests for the project creation store, snapshot builder, and ProjectCreationWizard components
steps: Step 1 - Create src/stores/__tests__/projectCreationStore.test.ts following the pattern in publishStore.test.ts. Mock @/lib/supabase (both fromTable and supabase.rpc). Test: initial state is IDLE, fetchAvailableTemplates populates templates list, selectTemplate updates selectedTemplate and advances to PROJECT_DETAILS step, setCustomerReference/setSiteReference update state, createProject calls supabase.rpc with correct params (verify p_template_id, p_user_id, p_idempotency_key, p_snapshot_data, p_snapshot_hash), createProject success transitions to CREATED step with project id, createProject error transitions to ERROR step with error message, reset returns to initial state.

Step 2 - Create src/lib/__tests__/snapshotBuilder.test.ts. Test: buildSnapshotData returns correctly structured object with all frozen fields (wall_geometry, zones with sku data, lighting, furniture, trims), computeSnapshotHash returns consistent hex string for same input, computeSnapshotHash returns different values for different inputs, snapshot data includes zone SKU freeze data when zoneSku map has entries.

Step 3 - Create src/components/ProjectCreation/__tests__/ProjectCreationWizard.test.tsx following the pattern in BomPanel.test.tsx. Mock @/lib/supabase. Test: wizard does not render when step is IDLE, wizard renders DesignLibrary when step is BROWSE_TEMPLATES, wizard renders ProjectDetailsForm when step is PROJECT_DETAILS, template cards are displayed when templates are loaded, clicking Select on a template card advances to PROJECT_DETAILS, filling in details and clicking Create calls createProject, error state shows error message and retry button, New Project button only shows for CONSULTANT role.
acceptance_criteria: Store tests at src/stores/__tests__/projectCreationStore.test.ts cover all actions and state transitions
Snapshot builder tests at src/lib/__tests__/snapshotBuilder.test.ts verify data assembly and hashing
Component tests at src/components/ProjectCreation/__tests__/ProjectCreationWizard.test.tsx verify UI rendering and interactions
All new tests pass: vitest run reports no failures
All existing 175 tests continue to pass
Tests exercise actual code paths - not just static assertions

findings: All 48 new tests pass. The createProject store tests needed careful mock chaining because fromTable().select().eq().order() is used for template_zone queries while fromTable().select().eq() (thenable) is used for other tables. Created a mock pattern where .eq() returns an object with both .order() and .then() methods. DesignLibrary component tests required mocking fetchAvailableTemplates as a no-op because the useEffect on mount would otherwise override test state. Total test count went from 175 to 223. crypto.subtle.digest works natively in vitest/jsdom.
